provenance.extraction: Google Sheets CSV export of the standings sheet.
provenance.jvNote: The JV tables are the sheet’s JV Place and JV Record columns, in its JV order. James Lick has no JV row: the sheet prints no JV record for it.
notes: Official BVAL sheet titled "BVAL Boys Basketball / 2025 - 26 Team Standings", linked from bval.org/standings. Varsity order is the sheet's own "Place".
Records only: the sheet has Overall and League Record per school and no points, goals or tiebreak data, so none are stored or computed.
Records are written as the sheet prints them (W-L), without the spaces around each hyphen; the sport has no ties, so t is 0.

Places are the sheet's, ties included: Christopher and Westmont (2); Pioneer and Leigh (5); Piedmont Hills and Lincoln (3); Sobrato and Silver Creek (3). A tied place is stored as printed, and the next place skips.

The 2025-26 divisions are the sheet's (Mt. Hamilton; Santa Teresa North, "Santa Teresa - North" in the sheet; Santa Teresa South, "Santa Teresa - South" in the sheet; West Valley), not 2026-27's in lib/registry/basketball/bval.ts. Santa Teresa North and Santa Teresa South are divisions BVAL no longer has (seasonAlignment.pastDivisions). Santa Teresa and Almaden Valley did not exist in 2025-26. Filed elsewhere in 2026-27: Branham (Santa Teresa North), Independence (Santa Teresa North), Piedmont Hills (Santa Teresa North), Lincoln (Santa Teresa North), Prospect (Santa Teresa North), Mt. Pleasant (Santa Teresa North), Leland (Santa Teresa South), Live Oak (Santa Teresa South), Sobrato (Santa Teresa South), Silver Creek (Santa Teresa South), Gilroy (Santa Teresa South), Oak Grove (Santa Teresa South), Overfelt (West Valley). The registry is not changed; the page says these teams moved.

JV is stored from the JV Place and JV Record columns, ordered on the JV place (the sheet's row order among equal places); tied JV places: Westmont and Santa Teresa (3); Live Oak and Silver Creek (2); Gunderson and Andrew Hill (3). No JV row for James Lick: its JV record is not a record ("n/a" or empty).
No all-league awards: this sport's BVAL all-league documents are not transcribed, so every division's awards are null.

provenance.extraction: Standings: pdftotext -layout. All-league awards: By hand, from pdftotext -layout of each PDF; each row is [player, school, position, year] as printed.
notes: SCVAL boys basketball, from scval.com/standings. Rows are in the PDF's own "SCHOOL by finish" order; nothing is recomputed, since the PDF carries no game-level data.
The PDF's "Overall record" column is empty, so every overallRecord is null.
Division membership is the 2025-26 PDF's, which is not the 2026-27 alignment; the page says which teams moved.
School spellings are the documents' own ("Mt. View", "Monta VIsta"); `slug` is the join key.
Grades are stored as 9-12 whatever the document wrote ("Jr", "Junior", "Soph", "Frosh", "11").
An overall award is stored as "Player, School, Position, Grade" from the document's four cells. Two players named for one award are two entries under the same title.
Records are W-L: a basketball game cannot end level, so the PDF prints no ties and t is stored as 0.
Each all-league document names one MVP and a first, second and third team; there is no honorable mention.
JV membership is varsity's in both divisions.
